lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters; clusters are more densely packed in the anterior region posterior to the gill slits and increase in spatial separation toward the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows of blobs to form a repeating grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the visible lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two dominant horizontal linear features displaying a sharp vertical gradient, with high-luminance values on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge, running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-to-moderate distribution of small high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the posterior margin and distal tip of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: An elongated, low-luminance object (consistent with a remora) is attached to the ventral-lateral surface immediately posterior to the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
